scope: Pipeline changes since the 2026-10-13 audit (pack 2.3.29), and the compatibility changes made for them. The 2.3.29 baseline is the Portal release manifests (dev.lampas.town /api/v1/releases/2.3.29/{client,server}-manifest), compared by artifact id and filename with the local 2.3.44 manifests and lock.

changed_affecting_overrides.finding: 9 of 302 archive entries changed: fabric.mod.json, MixinEntity (entity variable map is now Object2FloatOpenHashMap), and animation-math compilation (EMFMath, ASMParser, MultiASMAnimationHandler, MathBinaryExpressionComponent). EMFModelPartRoot and EMFDirectoryHandler, which the boat hook reads reflectively, are byte-identical. The boat water-mask EMF profile moved to 3.3.12 with this hash; 3.3.11 is retired.

4 of 7810 archive entries changed: META-INF/MANIFEST.MF, fabric.mod.json (version 4.3 -> 4.3.3), and boat entity/item registration in WWEntityTypes and WWItems (registerBoat/registerChestBoat take Supplier<Item> instead of DeferredItem through new lambdas, and registerAbstractBoat passes a no-op Consumer to a five-argument register). All client classes and data/wilderwild/worldgen/configured_feature/stone_pool.json (SHA-256 59cf59a1c1e86f9627361e1dcec3250b81d535c6e84ff7c3b2950d9b90f2efe4) are byte-identical. The stone-pool resource patch and the boat provider profile moved to 4.3.3 with this hash; 4.3 is retired.

changed_not_affecting_overrides.note: The locked 1.0.1 (SHA-256 63af43ef…) predates this change and still pins EMF 3.3.11 and Wilder Wild 4.3. The rebuilt 1.0.1 (2f0ac7bd…) is not yet staged in pack/custom.

pack_metadata_review.criterion: Data-bearing mods whose pack.mcmeta does not cover 26.2 data format 107.1, the defect class patched for Formations Overworld, Grim Kingdoms, Pyrite and Easter's Delight.
pack_metadata_review.data_bearing_ok: Better Village 4.0.1 and Library Ferret 5.0.1 declare min/max 107; Collective 8.53 declares 107.1; Apotheosis 10.0.2, Apothic Attributes 4.0.2, Gateways 7.0.2, Combat Roll 3.0.1, More Barrel Variants 2.1.1, More Lectern Variants 1.10.0 (root) and Lampas Addons 1.0.1 ship no root pack.mcmeta.
pack_metadata_review.more_lectern_variants_1_10_0: Adds built-in datapack resourcepacks/mlecternv-quad-compat declaring pack_format 71, supported 15-81. MoreLecternVariants registers it only when isModLoaded("quad"); no Quad mod is in the lock, so it is not registered. No patch.
pack_metadata_review.client_assets_only: Leawind Third Person (48), Perspective API (34) and Camera Entity Fade (15) declare legacy root pack_format values, the same pattern ETF ships unchanged in 7.2.5 and 7.2.6 (pack_format 9). Not patched; client resource loading of these mods was not run.
pack_metadata_review.result: No new resource patch is needed.

unchanged_pinned_targets: Every compatibility-targets.json entry with an artifact_sha256 (Beautiful Enchanted Books, Beautiful Potions, IllagerBlabber, Wilder Wild 4.3.3, Rogues, Puzzles Lib, Chatting, Lootr, Trinkets, Figura) matches a 2.3.44 lock artifact. The other pinned targets keep the filenames and versions they had in 2.3.29, so the 2026-10-13 fingerprint results still apply; they were not re-run.

boat_water_mask_probe.minecraft_root: Launcher-style root assembled with hardlinks from PrismLauncher libraries (net.minecraft 26.2, LWJGL 3.4.1, Fabric Loader 0.19.5) because %APPDATA%/.minecraft-lampas no longer exists; client 40896ee9..., loader 93044e4d... and Mixin 1f0ae44d... match the 2026-10-06 runs.
boat_water_mask_probe.baseline: PASS, exit 0; with FA Extensions enabled all 108 supported hulls (Pyrite 52, Promenade 6, Wilder Wild 10, BetterEnd 18, BetterNether 22) are plain while the water patch is the selected boat_patch.jem EMF root (defect present on EMF 3.3.12)
boat_water_mask_probe.patched: PASS, exit 0; BoatRendererMixin applied; with FA on exactly those 108 renderers changed to vanilla mask geometry; hull signatures equal to baseline for all 134 renderers; rafts, BloomingNature and vanilla boats unchanged; FA-off stages identical to baseline

verification_limits: Static checks: lock and cached artifact hashes, archive entry diffs, javap diffs of changed classes, and pack.mcmeta review.

Runtime coverage is the isolated boat-mask client probe pair above. No dedicated server or full-pack client ran against pack 2.3.44; the Wilder Wild 4.3.3 stone-pool patch is covered by unit tests and the byte-identical resource only.
Gameplay, visual rendering and shader behavior of boats remain unverified.
